valuation.method: Forward non-GAAP EPS x P/E: FY2027 EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027). Native USD listing, no ADR conversion. Build: 2026 revenue guide $13.15-13.25B, non-GAAP opex about $6.0B (incl. Crinetics), non-GAAP tax 19.5-20.5%, 255.2M diluted shares in Q3 (Q3 non-GAAP EPS $4.76); FY2027 revenue assumed about $14.6B, ~12% COGS, opex ~$6.4B, $4.5B term loan interest, ~252M shares. EPS and multiples are analyst-style estimates, not company guidance.

bear.driver: CF growth stalls on Trikafta erosion, Alyftrek ramp slow, povetacicept delayed

base.driver: Revenue about $14.6B on Alyftrek conversion, Journavx and Casgevy growth; Crinetics opex absorbed

bull.driver: Povetacicept approval and fast launch, pain and kidney pipeline progress, margin leverage

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $20.00 the close of $538.60 implies 26.9x; the sampled analyst targets (about $442-$598) imply 22x-30x on the same EPS.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $20 (3.7 pp of the close)
valuation.watch_metric: Povetacicept FDA decision (PDUFA Nov 30, 2026) and Alyftrek/CF revenue trend vs Trikafta decline
valuation.next_disclosure: FDA decision on povetacicept by Nov 30, 2026; Q4 2026 earnings around late Feb 2027

analyst_notes: Only a small sample of dated calls could be verified; several November 2026 target raises were reported in headlines (to about $600-$650) but could not be opened, so they are excluded. Sampled targets are $442 to $598 and are stale relative to the Q3 report. Canaccord is the lone Hold; spread reflects multiple (22x-30x) more than EPS.
